envelope_rules.encoding: UTF-8 JSON; RFC8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) for unsigned manifest, strict integer/finite numbers only
envelope_rules.duplicate_object_keys: REJECT during JSON parse before canonicalization, including nested; no silent last-key-wins
envelope_rules.unicode: JCS-preserved Unicode, prohibit unpaired surrogates, producer_identity/signer_id ASCII regex ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$
envelope_rules.timestamp: UTC RFC3339 exact YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, no timezone offset/fractional seconds for synthetic candidate; clock mismatch/expiry fail closed
envelope_rules.float_semantics: FORBID floats in manifest (use integer counters, string digests and names). View payload future numeric values must be finite and use exact frozen RD5 semantics; no numeric gate invented

signed_domain.wire_encoding: UTF8; '\u0000' denotes one 0x00 byte in the signing domain, not two literal backslash+u characters

envelope_rules.serialization_algorithm: JCS(unsigned_manifest), where unsigned_manifest removes only 'signature' and 'signed_payload_digest' and is otherwise an exact frozen field set; view_id and audit_receipt_id must be independently determined, not self-hashes
envelope_rules.signature_algorithm: Ed25519 RFC8032 candidate: sign UTF8(domain)+JCS(unsigned_manifest). signature value = RFC4648 base64url(no padding) of 64 bytes. signed_payload_digest SHA256 of same bytes, non-authoritative without signature
envelope_rules.digest_algorithm: SHA-256 of exact view byte stream; lower-case hex 64; no reserialization after signing before compare
envelope_rules.trust_root: Only synthetic pinned independent public key in future tests, never production credentials; reject unknown, expired, revoked, wrong-role signers; key id SHA256(raw32byte_pubkey) lowercase
envelope_rules.nonce: 192-bit synthetic test vector generated deterministically and distinctly per scenario for repeatability; production entropy requirement remains unqualified; receiver+fold+signer+nonce single-use atomically reserved
envelope_rules.anti_replay: Single-use persistent ledger keyed by trust_root_id, signer_id, receiver_identity, fold_id and nonce; atomic replay protection must fail closed under concurrency; deletion/retry protocol BLOCKED until synthetic qualification
envelope_rules.ordering: authenticate header signature and permissions first; then bounded view bytes and rows; no downstream consumer receives unvalidated bytes
envelope_rules.output_surface: only controlled categorical stop code, IDs, count and digests after recursively validated allowlist; never raw errors, X/y, coefficients, paths, predictions
envelope_rules.real_trust_attestation: NOT_ESTABLISHED: signature alone cannot assert filesystem read constraints, legitimate historical owner, or data governance

manifest_fields.name: schema_version
manifest_fields.rule: exact 'ATDS_RD6_03A_TRAIN_VIEW_MANIFEST_V0_1'

manifest_fields.name: view_id
manifest_fields.rule: 64 lowercase hex derived from canonical unsigned payload excluding view_id, signature and audit_receipt_id; avoid self-reference

manifest_fields.name: view_format
manifest_fields.rule: exact 'JCS_JSON_LINES_SYNTHETIC_V0_1' candidate, not real implementation

manifest_fields.name: producer_identity
manifest_fields.rule: registered synthetic producer identifier, <=128 ASCII safe chars

manifest_fields.name: producer_authority_id
manifest_fields.rule: future signed human authorization ID; synthetic names are never real authority

manifest_fields.name: signer_id
manifest_fields.rule: exact trust-store signer binding

manifest_fields.name: signature_algorithm
manifest_fields.rule: ED25519_RFC8032_CANDIDATE, not authorized real cryptography

manifest_fields.name: trust_root_id
manifest_fields.rule: synthetic fixture trust root exact key identifier

manifest_fields.name: canonical_source_identity
manifest_fields.rule: metadata-only immutable Git blob, declared digest, parent repo and governed data authority; no source bytes

manifest_fields.name: source_access_scope
manifest_fields.rule: exact role, allowed synthetic origin, explicit DENY real ledger/test, max bytes/paths and expiry

manifest_fields.name: scientific_contract_identities
manifest_fields.rule: RD2/RD3/RD5 Git blobs + frozen week calendar, feature, response and TAU, no loose names

manifest_fields.name: fold_id
manifest_fields.rule: 1..5, type integer not boolean

manifest_fields.name: ordered_train_block_ids
manifest_fields.rule: exact ['B1'..'Bf']

manifest_fields.name: ordered_train_week_ids
manifest_fields.rule: exact canonical 44/87/130/173/216 target Mondays; no test

manifest_fields.name: current_test_week_denylist_digest
manifest_fields.rule: 64 lowercase SHA256 hex of canonical public list of B(f+1) target week IDs only; no responses

manifest_fields.name: train_row_count
manifest_fields.rule: positive within explicit future budget, exact match to view bytes

manifest_fields.name: train_class_counts
manifest_fields.rule: exact keys '0','1', integer >=0, sum equals count

manifest_fields.name: event_id_uniqueness_rule
manifest_fields.rule: exact 'GLOBAL_UNIQUE_WITHIN_ADMITTED_VIEW'

manifest_fields.name: cluster_boundary_rule
manifest_fields.rule: exact 'NO_CLUSTER_CROSSES_UNAUTHORIZED_TRAIN_WEEK'

manifest_fields.name: view_byte_length
manifest_fields.rule: positive, bounded by future human resource limit, not invented

manifest_fields.name: view_content_digest
manifest_fields.rule: SHA256 lowercase hex over immutable exact serialized view bytes

manifest_fields.name: canonical_serialization_id
manifest_fields.rule: exact 'RFC8785_JCS_UTF8_NODUPKEYS_FINITE_ONLY' for manifest candidate; row encoding separately specified

manifest_fields.name: receiver_identity
manifest_fields.rule: exact consumer identity bound to grant

manifest_fields.name: view_nonce
manifest_fields.rule: base64url no padding of 24 random bytes, deterministic fixture nonce source allowed only synthetic

manifest_fields.name: anti_replay_policy
manifest_fields.rule: exact 'ATOMIC_SINGLE_USE_RECEIVER_FOLD_SIGNER_NONCE' candidate

manifest_fields.name: expiration_policy
manifest_fields.rule: issue and expire UTC instants with nonnegative TTL bounded by separately chosen human limit

manifest_fields.name: audit_receipt_id
manifest_fields.rule: distinct controlled reference, <=128 safe chars

manifest_fields.name: producer_access_attestation
manifest_fields.rule: identity of producer binary/process/FS deny controls; unverified real values forbidden

manifest_fields.name: signed_payload_digest
manifest_fields.rule: SHA256 of domain-separated signed payload bytes

manifest_fields.name: signature
manifest_fields.rule: base64url no padding 64-byte Ed25519 signature over fixed domain + canonical unsigned payload

payload_candidate.byte_stream: Synthetic-only canonical UTF8 JSONL with exactly one RFC8785-JCS row-object per line, LF newline; strict 10 frozen fixture fields; RFC8785 finite numbers; fixed ordered rows (target_week_id,event_id); forbid duplicate JSON keys and trailing data
payload_candidate.prohibit: real historical source, current-fold test events, extra raw metadata, performance/test scores, model coefficients
payload_candidate.format_interoperability: JCS JSONL candidate pending human approval; adjust only by separate adjudication before executable implementation

unresolved_material_choices: Production clock skew, exact TTL and expiry policy
Atomic anti-replay state mechanism and failure recovery
Operational source owner authority and real source exposure
Synthetic algorithm interoperability and human adoption prior to RD6-03B
